description.p: TSM Desktop is an independent TradeSkillMaster companion for World of Warcraft players on Linux. It synchronizes local AppHelper realm data, manages TSM addon updates, exports Accounting data, and displays local Auction House prices.
The self-contained x86_64 AppImage supports automatic updates, system-tray operation, multiple World of Warcraft flavors, and credentials protected by the Linux Secret Service.
This application is unofficial and is not affiliated with or endorsed by TradeSkillMaster, Blizzard Entertainment, or Wowhead.
